about_the_game:
Prop Haunt is a psychological horror 4v1 multiplayer game where you play as either a Ghost or an Investigator. As a Ghost, haunt objects, gather energy, and scare Investigators to stop them from identifying your haunted items. As an Investigator, use cameras to find haunted objects while dodging the Ghost’s tricks—like power outages, slowdowns, and terrifying scares. Outsmart your opponents in this thrilling spooky game!

CAMERA-BASED INVESTIGATION

Become the Investigator. Armed only with cameras, the investigator must scan rooms for signs of the paranormal. A chair moving on its own? A toaster floating? Every subtle sign matters in this supernatural showdown. Acquire power by zapping haunts to use the ultimate and stun ghosts or lock them in rooms temporarily to stop them from taking over. Survive the night to win!

HAUNT THE INVESTIGATOR AWAY

Join a ghoulish team. Join 3 other ghosts and rack up points by haunting as many objects as possible—the more you haunt, the more powerful you'll become! But be careful—if you make it too obvious, you'll only help the investigator. Stay one step ahead by teleporting between rooms, choosing the perfect objects to haunt without giving yourself away.

GHOSTS GROW STRONGER OVER TIME

The more haunted objects remain active, the more energy ghosts build. With enough power, they can mess with the investigator— turn off the power, open the garage door to slow down the investigation, and scaring the hell out of them! Or use your power to destroy rooms and cut the investigator off from them for good.

WORK TOGETHER AS GHOSTS TO TAKE OVER

Once the ghosts have enough power, they can work together to destroy rooms so the investigator can no longer use their cameras there. With enough rooms destroyed the ghost will take over and win the match!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4170 or AMD FX-8120
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2080
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4170 or AMD FX-8300 or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

short_description: Prop Haunt is a 4v1 multiplayer psychological horror game. Take on the role of spirits focused on expanding their influence on the physical world by haunting objects, or play as an investigator assigned to report on these hauntings to reduce the amount of paranormal activity in the world.
